style: An oil painting of 1893, painted alla prima in the manner of Sargent, Atkinson Grimshaw and the Victorian narrative painters: visible loose brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin transparent glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges, broken colour, canvas weave showing through; night, deep shadows, warm lamplight against cold blue darkness, in the dark tone of a gothic Victorian nocturne; figures small or in silhouette, no detailed faces. Not an illustration, not digital art. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, lettering, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: establishing, far. The gothic red-brick asylum at Purfleet at three in the morning, one upper window brightly lit with lamps, shadows of figures moving behind its blind; bare trees, a dark lawn, cold blue night.

Shot: wide interior, no faces. A long asylum corridor at night; at its far end an open cell door spills hard white lamplight across the floor, small figures in white coats bent over something inside, the rest of the corridor in deep shadow.
Shot: very wide. The asylum lawn at night under a bright moon, a thin white mist creeping low across the grass from the high wall of the neighbouring old estate, a stone statue half drowned in mist.

Shot: far, exterior, looking in. Through the barred window of a lamplit cell seen from the dark garden: inside, four men waiting in silence around a bed, in silhouette, one lamp on a table; ivy and wet brick around the window.
Shot: medium, no people. A doctor's study at night: a mantel clock showing a few minutes before three, a guttering lamp, an open surgical case on the desk, a window with the moon behind the blind.
Shot: establishing, far. Over a high garden wall at night: the ruined chapel of an old deserted estate, Carfax, black against a moonlit sky, mist rising among dead trees.
Shot: far. Night mist pouring over the top of a high old wall like slow water and spilling across a moonlit lawn towards the lit windows of a large Victorian building.
Shot: far, exterior. The asylum at night under a brilliant full moon; one bedroom window's thick yellow blind glows pale with moonlight; a thread of white mist curls up the wall to the sill.
Shot: wide interior, no faces. A dark upper corridor of the asylum at night, a broken bedroom door hanging open, moonlight and a fallen lamp throwing long shadows, men's silhouettes rushing in.

Shot: very wide interior from the far dark corner of a book-lined study before dawn: a young woman in a white wrapper seated in the lamplight, a circle of men standing round her in shadow, all small, faces not seen.

Shot: far, exterior, looking in. From the dark garden before dawn through a tall lit study window: a small figure of a woman in white seated, men gathered round her; deep blue sky beginning to pale at the horizon.
Shot: establishing, far. The great dark house of Carfax and its chapel under a blood-tinged moon, bats against the sky, the asylum's lit windows small beyond the trees.
Shot: far, exterior. Seen from the lawn, a column of white mist rising from a moonlit bedroom window of the asylum and drifting away towards the black trees of Carfax.
Shot: medium-wide, no faces. A moonlit bedroom wall with a thick yellow blind; on it the huge shadow of a tall man in a long cloak bending over a bed; a candle guttering.
Shot: establishing, far. The asylum grounds at first dawn, the eastern sky turning pale gold and rose over bare trees and the dark wall of Carfax, mist lying on the lawn, one window still lamplit.
